question: does each §19 answer name the committed artifact its numbers come from?
why_not_number_matching: two earlier versions tried to infer provenance from numeric coverage. v1 called nearly everything traceable including Q2, which traces to nothing; v2's permutation null came out at ~0.90 for every answer, random figures scoring as well as real ones. With ~200 artifacts holding tens of thousands of floats, numeric coverage carries no information.
